description.value: Redwood Park is one of Surrey's most spectacular nature destinations, distinguished by a large forest of exotic tree species rarely found in the Lower Mainland. The park offers over 5 kilometres of scenic nature trails winding through the natural area, along with rustic picnic shelters and an all-access playground. It makes a pleasant detour or rest stop for cyclists exploring the South Surrey area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for Redwood Park at surrey.ca confirms address (17900 - 20 Avenue, Surrey BC), phone (604-501-5050), and describes the park as featuring over 5 km of nature trails, picnic shelters, and a wheelchair-accessible playground. No bike-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are explicitly mentioned in the available website text, so all amenity fields remain null. OSM provides no address or phone, so contact_confirmed reflects that OSM values cannot be cross-checked.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Redwood Park is a publicly accessible nature park with 5+ km of trails and notable exotic-tree forest — a legitimate and appealing attraction for touring cyclists in the South Surrey area.
